limitations: word_pool.room_select growth entries include internal reserve_words growth steps (checker_arena.bend:1104-1118), not only ordinary appends.
word_pool.room_select ordinary entries also include reserve_words reservation steps; word ordinary is therefore not a pure append count.
reserve_words bypasses metadata_write (checker_arena.bend:1113), so word-slot metadata_write counters do not cover reservation steps.
Counts are invocation counts through the emitted functions; they are not timings, allocations, or acceptance evidence.
Instrumentation adds one branch and six counter increments per call; it does not change returned values or fuel.

initialDraftFailure.diagnostic: Fixture draft used computed match scrutinees and an incorrect capacity expectation; replaced by a dependency-ordered public arena API regression. Initial failed smoke retained; not a compiler failure or a red-before-green optimization claim.

limitations: Room-select word counts include internal bulk-reservation iterations; their difference from metadata publications is not a direct saving count.
metadata fullAtWrite only measures post-write used==capacity, not growth; do not interpret it as growth.
At least two source Array.set calls per non-word ordinary append are redundant by the pool growth invariant; this is not a measured machine-store or allocation-byte count.
NaturalPool has zero entries in this frozen compiler workload; the mixed C/JS regression exercises it.
Counter instrumentation perturbs execution. Diagnostic wall time and guardian memory are not comparative performance acceptance.
